title: Xu Chu Fights Stripped to the Waist; a Letter Is Blotted on Purpose
summary: Xu Chu strips off his armour to fight Ma Chao and takes two arrows for it. Then Jia Xu ends the campaign without another battle: Cao Cao writes a friendly letter to Han Sui and smudges out the important passages himself before sending it.
Ma Chao reads it over Han Sui's shoulder, sees a letter that has been carefully edited, and concludes the obvious wrong thing. The coalition destroys itself within the week.
history: The altered letter is in the histories and is Jia Xu at his most characteristic: he wins by handing the enemy something to misread.

pins.note: Fights stripped to the waist, and takes two arrows.
Reads a letter, and destroys his own alliance.
Wins the campaign with an inkbrush.
